step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard illustrates an AWS architecture for AppGate SDP (Software Defined Perimeter) client remote access. The flow begins at a developer client (laptop). First, the client sends a Single Packet Authorization (SPA) to the AppGate Controller running on EC2 (flow 1, step 1). The AppGate Controller authenticates against identity providers including SSO and IAM (flow 1, steps 2-3) and returns an entitlement token back to the client (flow 1, step 4). Next, the client performs DNS resolution via Route 53 (flow 2). Finally, the client uses the issued entitlement token to connect securely through the AppGate Gateway (running on EC2) to access target resources inside the VPC (flow 3). AutoScaling is also depicted on the whiteboard for handling Gateway scaling.
